WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_score,
        AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) as score_sq,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_reaction,
        AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) as reaction_sq
    FROM measurements
)
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT m.* FROM measurements m
CROSS JOIN stats
WHERE NOT (
    m.cognitive_score < (stats.avg_score - 2 * sqrt(stats.score_sq - stats.avg_score*stats.avg_score))
    AND m.cognitive_score > (stats.avg_score + 2 * sqrt(stats.score_sq - stats.avg_score*stats.avg_score))
    AND m.reaction_ms >= 0
    AND m.reaction_ms < (stats.avg_reaction + 2 * sqrt(stats.reaction_sq - stats.avg_reaction*stats.avg_reaction))
)

    ) FROM statistics
)
AND (cognitive_score <=

        (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score*cognitive_score) FROM measurements) - 
        (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements) * 
        (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)
    ) FROM statistics
)
AND (reaction_ms >= MAX(0,
    (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements) - 2 * 
    (SELECT sqrt(
        (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) FROM measurements) - 
        (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements) * 
        (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)
    ) FROM statistics
)))
AND (reaction_ms <= 
    (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements) + 2 * 
    (SELECT sqrt(
        (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms*reaction_ms) FROM measurements) -

))
